data.name: My Fish Friend
data.detailed_description:
🌊 Welcome to a Stress-Free Underwater World

My Fish Friend is a peaceful, kid-friendly aquarium experience designed for toddlers (ages 2–3) and anyone who enjoys watching fish swim. Enjoy your own digital aquarium with 98 unlockable different fish and aquatic creatures, each with unique personalities, behaviors, and preferences. 

There are no goals, no timers, and no failure states — just calm exploration, gentle interaction, and learning through play.

Perfect for first-time gamers, families, educators, and anyone seeking a relaxing experience.

🫧 Gentle, Interactive Bubbles

  • Move the coral to create floating bubbles that rise naturally through the water

  • Click bubbles to pop them with a soft, satisfying “pop” and gentle animation

  • Bubbles spawn automatically every few seconds as you move the coral

  • Fish sometimes chase bubbles, creating playful, unpredictable moments

  • Bubbles pop on their own if untouched, keeping the aquarium clean and calm

The result is a mesmerizing underwater atmosphere that encourages curiosity and play.

🍽️ Feed Your Fish & Discover Their Favorites

Drop food into the aquarium and watch how each fish reacts differently based on personality and preference.

Food Types:

🐟 Fish Flakes

  • Drift slowly downward

  • Some fish chase eagerly, others glide calmly

  • Great for observing different swim styles

🦐 Tiny Shrimp

  • Fall at a moderate speed

  • Fish react with varied levels of excitement

  • Encourages patience and observation

✨ Pellets

  • Fish spin excitedly before chasing them

  • A favorite for visual delight

Each fish has a favorite food — drop it and they’ll swim at maximum speed with extra enthusiasm!

Food that reaches the bottom naturally disappears, keeping the aquarium tidy.

🐠 Unique Fish Personalities & Natural Behaviors

Every fish feels alive thanks to a rich personality system:

  • Different swimming speeds and movement styles

  • Individual reaction distances to food and bubbles

  • Favorite foods that trigger extra-excited behavior

  • Natural spacing preferences when following objects

  • Occasional bubble-chasing for playful variety

  • Intelligent obstacle and ground avoidance

  • Smooth, lifelike turns and navigation

🎮 Simple, Flexible Controls

Designed for comfort and accessibility:

Mouse Controls

  • Click to drop food

  • Click bubbles to pop

Keyboard Controls (Optional)

  • Space/Click – Drop food

  • WASD / Arrow Keys – Move the magic coral

  • 1 / 2 / 3 – Select food types

  • Q / E – Cycle food

  • Tab / Shift+Tab – Switch fish

  • Esc or C – Toggle controls menu

🎨 Calm Visuals & Gentle Audio

  • Soft ambient water sounds for relaxation

  • Friendly sound effects for every interaction

  • Smooth fish movement

  • Flakes, pellets, shrimp and floating bubbles

  • Fish always stay visible on screen

  • Clean, uncluttered interface for young users

Custom Audio Controls

Parents can adjust sound easily:

  • Master Volume

  • Sound Effects Volume

  • Ambient Music Volume

Perfect for children with sound sensitivity.

🐟 Fish Collection & Focused Play

  • Cycle through your fish collection with ease

  • Activate one fish at a time with no overstimulation

  • Clear visual and audio feedback when switching fish

The system handles everything automatically — no setup or management required.

🎓 Learning Through Play

My Fish Friend encourages early learning without pressure:

  • Learn the names of 98 fish and aquatic creatures

  • Understand cause and effect through interaction

  • Observe animal behavior and preferences

  • Develop hand-eye coordination and motor skills through popping bubbles

  • Build patience, attention, and curiosity

🌈 Perfect For

  • 👶 Toddlers (Ages 2–3)

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Parents & caregivers

  • 🏫 Early childhood education

  • ♿ Children with special needs

  • 🐠 Fish & aquarium lovers

  • 😌 Anyone seeking relaxation

  • 👵 Seniors looking for gentle interaction

✨ Key Features

  • 98 unique fish and aquatic species

  • No timers, no losing, no pressure

  • Interactive bubbles and feeding

  • Fish personalities and favorite foods

  • Mouse and keyboard controls

  • Customizable audio settings

  • Smooth animations and calming visuals

  • Educational, safe, and accessible design

💙 What Makes My Fish Friend Special

  • Designed specifically for toddlers

  • Learning happens naturally through play

  • Truly stress-free — no failure states

  • Accessible for all ages and abilities

  • Relaxing yet playful aquarium experience
